summary: Frontend-only test of OrderModal coupon/discount wiring in OrderModal.jsx. All 6 scenarios PASS: modal opens with unified 'Kode Voucher / Diskon (opsional)' field + 'Pakai' button; invalid code shows exact error text 'Kode tidak valid atau sudah expired ya, Sobat Creative 😢' (both toast + red text under field via data-testid='discount-invalid'); valid coupon TEST50 shows green badge 'Voucher 50% diterapkan — hemat Rp 22.500', renders summary-discount-row, and updates order-total-final from Rp 45.000 -> Rp 22.500; 'Hapus' button clears discount, empties field, restores total; order submission (transfer) with TEST50 applied succeeds — backend order ORD434386 persisted with product_price=22500 (discounted). Loyalty fallback path exists in code (falls back to GET /api/discount/validate/{code}) and same 'discount-invalid' branch fires when both fail — verified via invalid code path.

issues: Console warns: empty string ('') passed to img src attribute — product photo_url is empty for TEST Import1; should render null or fallback placeholder instead of empty string to avoid full-page re-download warning.

action_items: (Optional) Guard to skip render or use placeholder when photo_url is empty — currently emits React warning.

(Optional cleanup) Test data left in DB: coupon TEST50 (aadfaf28-...), order ORD434386 (TEST_AutoBuyer), and product '➥ TEST Import1' was toggled from draft -> published for testing. Main agent may want to revert publish_status back to 'draft' if this is production-adjacent.
critical_code_review_comments: OrderModal.jsx validateCode() correctly implements the sequential coupon -> loyalty -> error flow with exact required copy.
Discount amount calculation supports both percentage (loyalty) and fixed nominal (coupon) via discount_amount/percentage branches — correct.
buildPayload only sends discount_code when discountInfo.valid — good, avoids sending invalid codes to /orders.
seed_data_creation: Created coupon TEST50 (percentage 50, applies_to all, active) via POST /api/admin/coupons. Published product '➥ TEST Import1' via PATCH /api/admin/products/{id}/publish-status. Created order ORD434386 as part of test flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: TEST50 coupon exists in DB and can be reused. Test product slug 'test-import1' is now published. Loyalty-code positive path was not exercised (no seed loyalty code available); however the fallback logic path was validated via the invalid-code scenario which exhausts both branches.
